lessons.trigger_condition: The tablet could discover and display WATCH games, but verified emerging-market evidence was not represented in the adaptive market/release attention path and the WATCH list was displayed in registry order rather than evidence priority.
lessons.prevention_rule: Compute a bounded WATCH attention signal only from current verified registry review, official freshness and independent marketplace freshness. It may contribute only a small bounded amount to existing market/release UI attention and evidence-sort the read-only WATCH list. WATCH games remain excluded from allowed market selectors until the existing review persists PROMOTED state.
validation_required: watch_candidate_activity consumes current verified registry review and evidence freshness
WATCH attention is advisory only and cannot auto-promote or enable grading
market/release attention remain bounded by the existing maximum UI bias
market_lens.allowed_games continues to contain only core/promoted market games
tablet WATCH display sorts by evidence score and marketplace depth, never by predicted return
price direction profit prediction and user behavior tracking remain false
screen neural architecture remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 outputs
lessons.safety_boundary: Emerging attention changes UI prioritization only. It does not predict investment returns, invent market direction, enable purchase actions for WATCH games, rewrite source code at runtime, or grant the neural policy execution authority.

lessons.trigger_condition: Force of Will and the relaunched MetaZoo had current official operation and independent marketplace depth but were absent from the declarative registry, preventing continuous WATCH revalidation and later evidence-gated promotion.
lessons.prevention_rule: Seed Force of Will and MetaZoo as WATCH with activation_score 0.0, current public HTTPS official sources, independent marketplace sources, marketplace depth evidence, declared aliases and grading disabled. Promotion remains current-evidence-only through the existing registry review.
validation_required: Force of Will starts WATCH with conservative TCGplayer catalog depth 11216 and 2026 official organized-play activity
MetaZoo starts WATCH with TCGplayer catalog depth 3456 and current official relaunch/organized-play evidence
both games have activation_score 0.0 and grading false
neither game is selectable through enabled market/purchase controls until stored state becomes PROMOTED
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO remain the only grading-enabled game IDs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
lessons.safety_boundary: These are market-monitor candidates, not profit guarantees. Historical collectible value or relaunch hype cannot bypass current-source freshness, marketplace-depth, promotion, or grading-calibration gates.
